patch_description:
This design retains the parameter-efficient collective rotations that generalized well in the current program, but replaces the sparse cube entangler with an exact permutation-equivariant interaction. Every pair of qubits receives one CZ, producing a complete-graph quadratic phase—or collective one-axis twist—between noncommuting mixer layers.

Because the 28 encoded features correspond to two-qubit relationships, treating all qubit pairs identically removes the arbitrary reference graph introduced by the cube. The resulting hypothesis class is aligned with vertex-permutation-invariant record properties, which should reduce nuisance fitting and improve validation behavior. The 28 CZ gates are ordered as seven disjoint perfect matchings, giving the complete interaction layer its minimum possible two-qubit depth on eight qubits. Parameter sharing preserves the current total of only four circuit parameters per block, while the collective RY/RZ and RY/RX stages provide phase injection and phase-to-population conversion for the fixed Z readout.
